operation.description: Workflow control/read action. List returns Temporal workflow executions plus registered scheduled workflows that have no current execution. Trigger publishes current local source if needed before running. Use WorkflowUpdate, not this tool, for requested source or manifest changes.

workflow_id.description: Required for describe, trigger, pause, and resume. Not needed for list.

note.description: Optional schedule note for pause/resume or operator context.

limit.description: Maximum workflows to return for list.

include_completed.description: Include completed/closed Temporal workflow executions and deleted scheduled-workflow records when listing. By default list includes open Temporal executions and active/paused scheduled workflows.
